mechanics.name: Evergreen
mechanics.contract: Direct Regrowth or Healing Touch refreshes only the caster's existing Lifebloom, all three ranks, without altering stacks or strength.
mechanics.chain: Direct heal proc -> spell_proc positive Nature/Druid family mask 0x60 -> bound AuraScript Check -> same-caster periodic-heal aura with rank root 33763 -> RefreshDuration.

mechanics.name: Everliving
mechanics.contract: Effective direct or periodic Nature healing grants a stack; full overhealing grants none. Three percent per stack, maximum 15. Next Swiftmend consumes existing stacks; at 15 it preserves both charge and Rejuvenation/Regrowth.
mechanics.chain: Native heal sets effective healing before proc -> spell_proc heal/Nature masks -> parent Check and stack cast -> native 15-stack refresh -> Swiftmend OnCast snapshot -> charge consumption guard -> native HoT-consumption guard -> OnHit bonus once and old-stack removal -> healing proc may create a fresh stack -> AfterCast protection cleanup.
mechanics.coverage: 384 effective-healing/ownership/school/target/realm cases; native stack clamp/refresh/removal; all 0–15 Swiftmend snapshots; missed/no-hit and absent-parent handling; fresh stack survives old-stack cleanup; two charges and sequential 15-second recharge; full-stack cast preserves charge; other-mode and existing Charge metadata isolation.
mechanics.cleanup: Parent effect removal removes owned stack/protection auras idempotently. Old helper proc effects have zero proc flags and no proc SQL; parent effect 1 is disabled to prevent premature protection. Stack SpellModifier value suppressed only on Area 52 to prevent double healing amplification.
mechanics.limits: Native extracted charge state, stack functions and callbacks with mocked persistence/clock/packets; dispatcher ordering source-traced. No live healing or gameplay.
